# Legacy development build — do not distribute

This directory is an old online-license development build. Its configuration points to a local service at `http://127.0.0.1:8787`, so it is not usable by buyers and must not be packaged or sold.

Use the offline Ed25519 commercial candidate instead:

`dist/friberg-assistant-commercial/`

The repository security audit and commercial ZIP audit must continue to reject this localhost build as a buyer-ready package.
